name: MuSHRoom iPhone data: conventions and pose sources (koivu + vr_room)
source: Zenodo 10230733 (CC BY 4.0), koivu md5 a359dba7, vr_room md5 6c411b7b
notes: Chosen over ARKitScenes for the next ADR-006 test: real rooms, iPhone 12 Pro Max via Polycam, a separate test walk per room, laser-scan reference mesh. (1) transformations*.json are camera->world in the OpenGL camera frame: depth reprojection between frames 2 apart agrees within 5 cm for 60-80% of points under OpenGL vs 3-15% under OpenCV; our conversion reproduces 0.605 on vr_room. (2) koivu's transformations_colmap.json is an exact copy of the Polycam poses in both captures (COLMAP failed there, as the paper says), so the dataset has no image-only poses for koivu. (3) vr_room Polycam vs dataset COLMAP poses: 0.6 cm median, 1.5 cm p95, 26 cm max after similarity alignment; the dataset COLMAP poses are more depth-consistent (0.715 vs 0.604). (4) vr_room's short walk was tracked in its own Polycam frame (94 deg apart); only the dataset COLMAP poses place it in the long capture's frame, so they are used for the test walk. Consequence: our image-only arm is our own COLMAP run, not the dataset's poses. Frames: vr_room 422 long / 186 short (42 test.txt), koivu 309 images but 294 posed long / 121 short (29 test.txt)
